versions.content: Application of attribute NotAvailableValueSpecifica- tion . defaultPattern happens only during initialization The value of No- tAvailableValueSpecification . defaultPattern is applied only during the initialization of the respective DataPrototype . Therefore, if the optional element is not received during a specific reception, the mem- ory area is untouched. It is the duty of the application to check whether that optional element has actually been received.
